Innvolution Healthcare expands cardiology business in Indonesia August 15, 2026 | Saturday | News Company has supplied cardiovascular consumables in Indonesia for more than a decade India-based Innvolution Healthcare, which develops interventional cardiology technologies and cardiac catheterisation laboratory (cath lab) systems, has appointed international business development consultancy Intralink to identify and recruit a distribution partner to support the launch of its cath lab platform in Indonesia. Founded in 2010, Innvolution has established a strong presence in India and already expanded internationally into markets including Nepal, Bangladesh, Central Asia and Africa. The company has supplied cardiovascular consumables in Indonesia for more than a decade and is now preparing to introduce its cath lab systems to the market, offering hospitals access to advanced cardiac imaging technology as a cost-effective alternative to established international brands. Indonesia represents an important growth opportunity for Innvolution, with demand for cardiovascular care increasing and hospitals continuing to invest in specialist medical technology. The company has already engaged with leading cardiologists in the country and is now seeking a distribution partner with strong cardiology expertise and established relationships with major Indonesian hospitals. Intralink’s team in Jakarta will research and assess potential distributors before developing a shortlist and supporting Innvolution both through the process of selecting its partner and the commercial discussions that follow. Gaurav Agarwal, Managing Director of Innvolution Healthcare, said, “Indonesia is an important market for Innvolution as we continue to strengthen our international presence. We have already established a strong foundation in the country through our cardiovascular consumables business, and we now see a significant opportunity to bring our cath lab solutions to the Indonesian market." Innvolution Healthcare expands cardiology business in Indonesia
August 15, 2026 | Saturday | News
Company has supplied cardiovascular consumables in Indonesia for more than a decade
India-based Innvolution Healthcare, which develops interventional cardiology technologies and cardiac catheterisation laboratory (cath lab) systems, has appointed international business development consultancy Intralink to identify and recruit a distribution partner to support the launch of its cath lab platform in Indonesia.
Founded in 2010, Innvolution has established a strong presence in India and already expanded internationally into markets including Nepal, Bangladesh, Central Asia and Africa.
The company has supplied cardiovascular consumables in Indonesia for more than a decade and is now preparing to introduce its cath lab systems to the market, offering hospitals access to advanced cardiac imaging technology as a cost-effective alternative to established international brands.
Indonesia represents an important growth opportunity for Innvolution, with demand for cardiovascular care increasing and hospitals continuing to invest in specialist medical technology. The company has already engaged with leading cardiologists in the country and is now seeking a distribution partner with strong cardiology expertise and established relationships with major Indonesian hospitals.
Intralink’s team in Jakarta will research and assess potential distributors before developing a shortlist and supporting Innvolution both through the process of selecting its partner and the commercial discussions that follow.
Gaurav Agarwal, Managing Director of Innvolution Healthcare, said, “Indonesia is an important market for Innvolution as we continue to strengthen our international presence. We have already established a strong foundation in the country through our cardiovascular consumables business, and we now see a significant opportunity to bring our cath lab solutions to the Indonesian market."
